input.code:
orders = await orders_get_orders()
ids = [o["order_id"] for o in orders]
totals = {}
for o in orders:
    totals[o["region"]] = totals.get(o["region"], 0) + float(o["amount"])
return {
  "count": len(orders),
  "unique_ids": len(set(ids)),
  "regions": sorted({repr(o["region"]) for o in orders}),
  "statuses": sorted({repr(o["status"]) for o in orders}),
  "amount_types": sorted({type(o["amount"]).__name__ for o in orders}),
  "id_range": [ids[0], ids[-1]],
  "totals": {r: round(t, 2) for r, t in sorted(totals.items())},
}
